digest.component_or_area: plan-review gate with shared discovery kernel
propositions: Plan review must execute through the S2 shared typed kernel while preserving current YAML topology, concurrency bounds, cache warming, and cancellation behavior
Failed criterion units must not serialize as clean checkpoints; earlier successes survive and dependents skip per the approved failure policy

The checkpoint key must change when any input (material, code/ref, policy, prompt, contract, model, topology, context, dependency, namespace version) changes; legacy and corrupt entries produce zero reuse
Only content-identical success/resume envelopes can seed checkpoint reuse; failed, cancelled, skipped, and budget-shed units remain missing and callable in later runs
The reducer-ignored review journal stores the safe versioned trace and digest-complete envelopes while review-plan outputs remain narrow end-result contracts
Shadow comparison during migration must confirm identical call set, order, usage, budget, cache, and final verdict between legacy projection and new shared-kernel approach
